mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_identity_tenant (id, code, name, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_identity_user (id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_identity_membership (tenant_id, user_id, role, is_default, status, joined_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{defaultTenant}, #{status}, #{joinedAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.status AS user_status, m.tenant_id, t.status AS tenant_status, m.status AS membership_status, m.role FROM ainer_identity_user u JOIN ainer_identity_membership m ON m.user_id = u.id AND m.is_default = true JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.status AS user_status, m.tenant_id, t.status AS tenant_status, m.status AS membership_status, m.role FROM ainer_identity_user u JOIN ainer_identity_membership m ON m.user_id = u.id AND m.is_default = true JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE u.id = #{subjectId}

SELECT m.tenant_id, u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{subjectId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.tenant_id, u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( u.username LIKE #{likePattern} ESCAPE '!' OR lower(u.display_name) LIKE #{likePattern} ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY u.username, u.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.tenant_id, u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{subjectId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF m, u, t

SELECT t.status AS tenant_status, u.status AS user_status, m.status AS membership_status, ( SELECT e.occurred_at FROM ainer_identity_access_event e WHERE e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND e.subject_id = m.user_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS latest_revoked_at FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{subjectId}
SELECT status FROM ainer_identity_user WHERE id = #{subjectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id FROM ainer_identity_membership WHERE user_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY tenant_id

SELECT m.tenant_id, t.code AS tenant_code, t.name AS tenant_name, m.role, m.is_default FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{subjectId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.is_default DESC, t.name, m.tenant_id

SELECT m.tenant_id, u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.username, u.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_identity_membership m JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN ainer_identity_tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.tenant_id, u.id AS subject_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role FROM ainer_identity_tenant t JOIN ainer_identity_membership m ON m.tenant_id = t.id AND m.is_default = true AND m.role = 'OWNER' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN ainer_identity_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE t.code = #{tenantCode} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.username = #{username}
WITH lock_acquired AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{lockKey}, 0)) ) SELECT 1 FROM lock_acquired
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' AND ( tenant_code = #{tenantCode} OR (owner_username = #{username} AND owner_user_exists = false) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_identity_member_audit (id, tenant_id, actor_subject_id, target_subject_id, operation, role, reason_code, request_id, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorSubjectId}, #{targetSubjectId}, #{operation}, #{role}, #{reasonCode}, #{requestId}, #{occurredAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_identity_ownership_transfer (id, tenant_id, initiator_subject_id, target_subject_id, status, reason_code, request_id, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{initiatorSubjectId}, #{targetSubjectId}, #{status}, #{reasonCode}, #{requestId}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, initiator_subject_id, target_subject_id, status, reason_code, request_id, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, executed_at, executed_by_subject_id FROM ainer_identity_ownership_transfer WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, tenant_id, initiator_subject_id, target_subject_id, status, reason_code, request_id, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, executed_at, executed_by_subject_id FROM ainer_identity_ownership_transfer WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
